# Overview

This file performs the County Durham within-area analysis using the same 0-3 low-accessibility measure as Phase 1.

## 1. Setup and extraction

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

lsoa_map <- readRDS("data/processed/lsoa_map.rds")
un1_analytic <- readRDS("data/processed/un1_analytic.rds")
un1_uf1_analytic <- readRDS("data/processed/un1_uf1_analytic.rds")
selected_case_las <- readRDS("data/processed/selected_case_las.rds")

if (length(selected_case_las) != 1 || selected_case_las != "County Durham") {
  stop("The selected case must be County Durham. Re-run the final Phase 1 file.")
}

summarise_dose_response <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_inactivity = mean(inactive_rate),
      median_inactivity = median(inactive_rate),
      sd_inactivity = sd(inactive_rate),
      se = sd_inactivity / sqrt(n),
      t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_lower = mean_inactivity - t_critical * se,
      ci_upper = mean_inactivity + t_critical * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

case_data <- un1_analytic %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las)

case_attributes <- case_data %>%
  rename(LSOA21CD = lsoa21_code)

case_map <- lsoa_map %>%
  select(LSOA21CD, geometry) %>%
  inner_join(case_attributes, by = "LSOA21CD") %>%
  st_make_valid()

case_boundary <- lsoa_map %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
  st_make_valid()

stopifnot(
  nrow(case_data) > 0,
  nrow(case_map) == nrow(case_data),
  n_distinct(case_map$LSOA21CD) == nrow(case_map),
  !st_is_empty(case_boundary)
)

cat("Selected case:", selected_case_las, "\n")
cat("UN1 complete-case LSOAs:", nrow(case_data), "\n")
```

## 2. Internal distribution

```{r internal-distribution}
case_internal_distribution <- case_data %>%
  count(n_low_access_dimensions, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

print(case_internal_distribution)

case_dimension_combinations <- case_data %>%
  count(
    low_employment_accessibility,
    low_gp_accessibility,
    low_supermarket_accessibility,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

print(case_dimension_combinations)
```

## 3. County Durham maps

```{r map-dimensions}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = case_boundary,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = case_map,
    aes(fill = n_low_access_dimensions),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "plasma",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Low-accessibility\ndimensions",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Low-accessibility Dimensions in County Durham",
    subtitle = "Coloured areas are UN1 complete-case LSOAs; grey areas are outside the main sample"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_low_access_dimensions.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## 4. Main within-case analysis

```{r main-dose-response}
case_dose_response <- summarise_dose_response(
  case_data,
  n_low_access_dimensions
)

print(case_dose_response)
```

```{r main-dose-response-plot}
ggplot(
  case_data,
  aes(
    x = n_low_access_dimensions,
    y = inactive_rate,
    fill = n_low_access_dimensions
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Economic Inactivity by Low-accessibility Dimensions",
    subtitle = "County Durham, UN1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Economic inactivity rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_dose_response_boxplot.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r main-models}
case_trend_model <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_num,
  data = case_data
)

case_adjusted_data <- case_data %>%
  drop_na(deprivation_score)

case_adjusted_model <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_num + deprivation_score,
  data = case_adjusted_data
)

cat("Unadjusted model n:", nobs(case_trend_model), "\n")
print(summary(case_trend_model))

cat("\nDeprivation-adjusted model n:", nobs(case_adjusted_model), "\n")
print(summary(case_adjusted_model))
```

## 5. Spatial diagnostic of model residuals

```{r residual-morans-i}
run_moran_mc <- function(sf_data, value_col, nsim = 999L, seed = 1L) {
  usable <- sf_data %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    st_make_valid()

  nb <- poly2nb(usable, queen = TRUE)
  lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  set.seed(seed)
  moran.mc(
    usable[[value_col]],
    lw,
    nsim = nsim,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )
}

trend_residuals <- tibble(
  LSOA21CD = case_data$lsoa21_code,
  trend_residual = residuals(case_trend_model)
)

adjusted_residuals <- tibble(
  LSOA21CD = case_adjusted_data$lsoa21_code,
  adjusted_residual = residuals(case_adjusted_model)
)

case_map_residuals <- case_map %>%
  select(LSOA21CD, geometry) %>%
  left_join(trend_residuals, by = "LSOA21CD") %>%
  left_join(adjusted_residuals, by = "LSOA21CD")

case_moran_results <- tryCatch(
  list(
    trend_residual = run_moran_mc(
      case_map_residuals,
      "trend_residual"
    ),
    adjusted_residual = run_moran_mc(
      case_map_residuals,
      "adjusted_residual"
    )
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    warning("County Durham residual Moran's I was not completed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

print(case_moran_results)
```

## 6. UN1 + UF1 sensitivity analysis

```{r sensitivity-data}
case_data_sens <- un1_uf1_analytic %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las)

stopifnot(nrow(case_data_sens) > 0)

case_dose_response_sens <- summarise_dose_response(
  case_data_sens,
  n_low_access_dimensions_sens
)

print(case_dose_response_sens)
```

```{r sensitivity-models}
case_trend_model_sens <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num,
  data = case_data_sens
)

case_adjusted_data_sens <- case_data_sens %>%
  drop_na(deprivation_score)

case_adjusted_model_sens <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~
    n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num +
    deprivation_score,
  data = case_adjusted_data_sens
)

cat("Sensitivity unadjusted model n:", nobs(case_trend_model_sens), "\n")
print(summary(case_trend_model_sens))

cat("\nSensitivity adjusted model n:", nobs(case_adjusted_model_sens), "\n")
print(summary(case_adjusted_model_sens))
```

```{r sensitivity-plot}
ggplot(
  case_data_sens,
  aes(
    x = n_low_access_dimensions_sens,
    y = inactive_rate,
    fill = n_low_access_dimensions_sens
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity Analysis: Economic Inactivity by Low-accessibility Dimensions",
    subtitle = "County Durham, UN1 + UF1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Economic inactivity rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_sensitivity_boxplot.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
